_about: Layouts shared by many labels, for tex_bee_redraw.py: windows (x0, y0, x1, y1) and points are fractions of the label's width and height in its source picture; {name} slots are filled by each label's own words.

lg2026._about: LG's BEE refrigerator label, 2026-28 (and 2023-26) series: arch of five stars, black series band, green energy box, the model lines, green footer with the BEE logo.

items.t: *Under test conditions, when tested in accordance with relevant standards. Actual energy consumption
will depend on how the appliance being used.
Issued by Bureau of Energy Efficiency  www.beeindia.gov.in

samsung2026._about: Samsung's BEE refrigerator label (2023-26 and 2026-28 series): a white die-cut margin round a black outline, the arch of five stars, black series band, green energy box, the model lines, green footer with the BEE logo.

items.t: *Under test conditions, when tested in accordance with relevant standards. Actual energy consumption
will depend on how the appliance being used.
Issued by Bureau of Energy Efficiency  www.beeindia.gov.in

samsung2026b._about: Samsung's BEE refrigerator label as on the RT40 / RR24 pictures (2026-28 series): the same parts as samsung2026, laid out a little differently, the model code set apart from 'Model No.:' in a lighter face.

items.t: *Under test conditions, when tested in accordance with relevant standards. Actual energy consumption
will depend on how the appliance being used.
Issued by Bureau of Energy Efficiency  www.beeindia.gov.in

lg2026b._about: LG's BEE refrigerator label as on the GLT252 / GLT342 / GLT292 / GV-B23 pictures: the asterisk set close after the figure, the type at the right edge, 'India' in title case.

items.t: *Under test conditions, when tested in accordance with relevant standards. Actual energy consumption
will depend on how the appliance being used.
Issued by Bureau of Energy Efficiency  www.beeindia.gov.in

wp2026._about: The BEE 2026-28 refrigerator label as Whirlpool prints it (Godrej's register-backed label is drawn the same way): arch of five stars, black series band, green energy box with the asterisk apart, the model lines in a condensed bold, green footer with the BEE logo.

items.t: *Under test conditions, when tested in accordance with relevant standards. Actual energy consumption
will depend on how the appliance being used.
Issued by Bureau of Energy Efficiency  www.beeindia.gov.in

wp2026r._about: The BEE 2026-28 refrigerator label as Whirlpool's DAS207 picture shows it: a white die-cut margin round a black outline, the same parts as wp2026, the footer's fine print set in four lines broken after 'standards.'

items.t: *Under test conditions, when tested in accordance with relevant standards.
Actual energy consumption will depend on how the appliance being used.
Issued by Bureau of Energy Efficiency www.beeindia.gov.in

sw2024._about: Samsung's BEE washing-machine label, 2024-26 series: arch of five stars inside a black outline, black series band, green ENERGY CONSUMPTION box (kWh/kg/cycle), the model lines, green footer with the BEE logo and three lines of fine print.

items.t: * Under test conditions, when tested in accordance with relevant standards.
Actual energy consumption will depend on how the appliance being used.
Issued by Bureau of Energy Efficiency  www.beeindia.gov.in

ac2026._about: The BEE room air conditioner label (2026-27 series) as Lloyd prints it: a white die-cut margin round a black outline, the arch of five stars, black series band, green ENERGY EFFICIENCY box with the ISEER, the rating rows in two columns, green footer with the BEE logo and three lines of fine print.

items.t: *Under test conditions, when tested in accordance with relevant standards.
Actual energy consumption will depend on how the appliance being used.
Issued by Bureau of Energy Efficiency  www.beeindia.gov.in

wpsg._about: The BEE 'Power Savings Guide' washing-machine label (label period 2024-26) as Whirlpool prints it: arch of five stars, black band with a chevron below, the emblem in a ring, the ENERGY CONSUMPTION box with its green figure bar and label period, the rating table, the BEE logo with its registration code, two lines of fine print.

items.t: *Under test conditions, when tested in accordance with latest IEC 60456 standards.
Actual energy consumption will depend on how the appliance is being used.

hpsg._about: The BEE 'Power Savings Guide' washing-machine label (label period 2024-26) as Haier prints it: the Whirlpool layout's parts with Haier's spacing, 'Label Period : 1st Jan - 31st Dec' on one line, the registration code over a rule above the fine print.

items.t: *Under test conditions, when tested in accordance with latest IEC 60456 standards.
Actual energy consumption will depend on how the appliance is being used.

acpsg._about: The BEE 'Power Savings Guide' room air conditioner label (label period 2026-27): arch of five stars, black band with a chevron, the emblem in a ring, the ENERGY EFFICIENCY box with the ISEER in its green bar and the label period, the rating table, the BEE 'Energy is life' logo with the registration code, two lines of fine print.

items.t: *Under test conditions, when tested in accordance with ISO 16358 & based on 1600 operating hours per annum.
Actual electricity consumption will depend on how the appliance being used.
